I replied in #coastal-team to Bettina. I can't set up the recurring Monday 08:00 digest: I have no tool to schedule Slack posts here, and the scheduler I do have only saves output locally, so it wouldn't post to the channel.

I told her I can write a "Coastal week ahead" digest on request from #coastal-team, #coastal-random and open customer items. A true Monday schedule needs someone with workspace scheduling access to set it up.
